text:
maya: heads up — after the sse-proxy heartbeat jitter flag rollout in us-west, we're seeing coordinated reconnect spikes from tenants with many idle streams. looks like connections drop then thousands reconnect within a 10-40s window causing quota/billing surges :grimacing:
infra-bot: alert: sse_reconnect_rate spike detected for cluster-us-west-2 (pct90 reconnects up 18x). incident-id: INC-20230322-84
dan: can you paste a quick example of the reconnect pattern + any client logs? is this on the new jitter config or the fallback policy?
maya: reproducer attached — client stays idle ~5m, then heartbeat gets delayed and we get resume failures. most clients then immediately reconnect. no per-conn randomization in the canary config.
jeff: that matches what i saw in staging earlier. the canary accidentally set heartbeat_jitter_ms = 0 for the pool selector when using the new sticky-routing rollout. should be randomized per-conn.
alex: idea: add per-tenant jitter keyed by connection id and a small exponential backoff for resume attempts to prevent thundering herd. also add a quick quota-protect throttle in proxy so reconnects beyond X/s get 429 for 5s to smooth bursts.
maya: strong +1 to quota-protect throttle. customer already pinged success about unexpected charges. product is looping them in.
dan: paste of faulty snippet from flag repo:
```yaml
proxy:
  sse:
    heartbeat_interval_ms: 30000
    heartbeat_jitter_ms: 0  # oops, was supposed to be random between 0-5000
    resume_backoff_ms: 100
```
jeff: quick mitigation: revert the canary flag to previous config (heartbeat_jitter_ms unset) and deploy a proxy hotfix to gate immediate reconnects. i'll open a PR.
alex: for longer term: telemetry + console change request — add "per-tenant reconnect rate" and "reconnect/second heatmap" to streaming dashboard, plus an alert rule for >X/s sustained for 1m. we should surface this in rollout UX when toggling jitter/backoff flags.
maya: agreed. action items: 1) jeff revert canary (hotfix) 2) dan add quota-protect throttle in proxy (quick patch) 3) alex add dashboard + alert and include in rollout checklist 4) ops reach out to affected customer and offer credits. i'll own the coordination.
infra-bot: deploys: PR #4421 opened by jeff -> staging job started.
jeff: PR up, smoke tests running. will flip the flag if green.
dan: i'll prototype the throttle patch, should be small. posting snippet soon.
maya: thanks team — keeping this thread as single source. please post eta updates here. :thumbsup:
